title: Reconcile active evidence and hosted snapshots

sources.reason: Authoritative remediation request and acceptance boundary.
Current active Work Item evidence creation path.

riskAssessment.reason: A snapshot must bind exact active evidence without turning ignored working evidence into unrelated commits.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

preReviewWarnings: Review that receipt binding cannot authorize a push, merge, archive, or unrelated evidence commit.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A hosted snapshot automatically includes and digest-binds the active Contract, Summary, and required active evidence without a manual force-add.
The snapshot fails closed when active evidence is dirty, omitted, or drifts after receipt creation, while unrelated files are not staged or committed by the snapshot command.
Clean and drift lifecycle regressions prove reproducible snapshot creation and receipt validation.
Lifecycle and command documentation explain the automatic evidence boundary and retain that snapshots do not grant provider-operation authority.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: Active Contract and Summary are ignored by default, but hosted verification requires a clean committed candidate and binds their digests. Users currently need manual force-add, which is error-prone and can pollute unrelated commits.
constraints: Do not make the snapshot command stage, commit, push, merge, archive, or delete files.
Do not loosen digest or clean-tree validation.
Keep unrelated working files outside the active-evidence policy.
intent.rationale: A declared and validated active-evidence boundary makes the measurement candidate reproducible without requiring unsafe manual staging.

rawUserRequest: Issue #616: reconcile ignored active Contracts/Summaries with clean committed hosted snapshots through one automatic, reproducible active-evidence policy.

declaredIntent.summary: Repair repository-governance evidence lifecycle consistency without provider-side operations.
